name: Alsómocsolád (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsómocsolád (a blue shield with a white and green well-sweep on a green mound) between the inscriptions ALSÓMOCSOLÁD above and KÖZSÉG below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
